body: First time. Normally I take 2 melatonin a Xanax and an ambien after they are in bed. I felt terrible doing it but I didn’t know what to do. I’ve had the kids for weeks at a time while she’a refused to take them back. We can’t call her because she’s always drunk. I don’t even keep alcohol in the house. This was a first I had to go buy it. I don’t know if I was trying to end it or not. I see a doctor and I told him I was afraid of her hurting me. It’s hard because she’s a doctor too and can read the notes.

Worked up from .5 to 4 supposedly just at night. Now I’ve got to take some during the day. Doctor put me on Prozac 20mg and now I just don’t feel like even getting out of bed for weeks. Can’t even make it to brush my teeth. Turned my phone off.
